thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — Dev Meetup (Booth B12) next Tue. Two urgent things: final swag counts and lead routing + post-show webinar follow-up. Can ops confirm pickup ETA?
Aj Patel: Ops ETA is 07:00 loading dock B unless traffic. I can confirm truck number tomorrow.
Leo Rivera: For swag: current PO shows 150 stickers, 100 tees, 50 water bottles, 20 laptop stickers (metal).
Ben H: Heads up — vendor just called: tees delayed, will only deliver 60 by event. rest ship next week.
Maria Chen: Ugh. OK plan B ideas? we need something to hand out at scale and not look like cheap filler.
Sophia Kim: We can bump up sticker pack + 1-off promo code for free tee preorder. Also have 50 branded drawstring bags we can bring.
Aj Patel: Suggest swap: give sticker pack + water bottle to first 100, drawstring bag + 1-in-5 tee raffle for the next 50. Keeps perceived value.
Leo Rivera: Agreed. I'll update the swag list and print a small "tee preorder" card with QR.
Maria Chen: Perfect. Who can update the shipping manifest and booth checklist? Push to ops.
Eli (ops-bot): Shipping manifest updated: Truck #42, ETA 07:00. Assigned loader: Alan M. Loading dock contact: +1-555-0132.
Maria Chen: Adding the venue logistics here for reference:
```
Shipping to: Convention Center - Loading Dock B
Contact: Alan M +1-555-0132
Arrival window: 06:00-08:00
Items planned:
- 2x 6ft tables
- 1x 8ft banner (pop-up)
- 150 x sticker packs (3 stickers each)
- 60 x tees (event day)
- 50 x water bottles
- 50 x drawstring bags
- Contactless lead scanner kit (iPad + Square/QR)
```
Aj Patel: Lead routing: plan is QR -> HubSpot form with hidden field source=devmeet-2026 -> workflows tag leads as "booth" and enroll in webinar drip. Confirm?
Maria Chen: Yes. Also want immediate SMS opt-in prompt on thank-you page for same-day demo slots. Keep legal opt-in language short.
Leo Rivera: I'll wire the QR to https://rwd.in/devmeet/scan?src=hubspot — HubSpot form fields: name, company, email, interest_area, schedule_demo (y/n).
Sophia Kim: Speaker update: my talk is confirmed at 11:15am (topic: "Serving LLMs at scale — cost vs latency tradeoffs"). Need AV checklist: mic, clicker, laptop HDMI adaptors.
Ben H: Design will print a small slide "Join our post-show webinar" with short link and QR for registrants. Draft copy below: "Missed the talk? Join our 30-min webinar on Wed 3/18 — practical tips to cut inference costs 2x."
Maria Chen: Love the webinar tie-in. Follow-up flow: immediate email (thank you + link to webinar sign-up), 24h reminder to those who signed up, and a 72h benchmark narrative (mini blog) w/ vetted numbers. Who owns benchmark write-up?
Aj Patel: Research/ML will own benchmark draft. I'll coordinate access to the post-show prompt sets. Aim for a 1-page summary + 3 charts.
Leo Rivera: For inbound routing, add a tag rule: if interest_area contains "benchmark" or "cost", set lifecycle->MQL and route to AJ. Otherwise route to SDR queue.
Maria Chen: Also want tracking for demo conversion from booth vs. webinar. Use utm_source=devmeet-booth and utm_campaign=devmeet2026.
Ben H: Quick copy suggestion for booth sign: "Try Redwood: same API everywhere. Live demo at 2pm. Scan to join webinar + get sticker pack."
Sophia Kim: AV check — does venue provide HDMI -> USB-C adapters? I can bring 1, but recommend we pack 2x adapters and a spare clicker.
Eli (ops-bot): AV checklist noted and added to manifest.
Maria Chen: One last thing — post-show social post draft: "Thanks #DevMeetNYC — great convos about production inference. Missed us at the booth? Watch the short webinar: rwd.in/devmeet/webinar #LLM #inference" Thoughts?
Aj Patel: Shorten link to rwd.in/devmeet/webinar and add a 2-line stat from benchmark later. Keep hashtags minimal.
Leo Rivera: I'll schedule the tweet for 30m after teardown with image of the booth. Can we confirm photography? Ben H can take pics.
Ben H: Yup, I'll be on photo duty. Will capture booth + slide with webinar QR.
Maria Chen: Great. Action items: Aj confirm HubSpot form + workflows (due EOD), Leo update QR + utm links, Ben update signage + take photos, Sophia confirm AV + final slide, Ops confirm truck + manifest (Eli). Returning to chat tomorrow for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
